title: Contribution Classes Separation Contract
description: Governs the strict statistical and architectural separation of participant contributions across CORE_PRE_RESULT, EXPOSED, and ADVOCACY_SUPPORT classes, guaranteeing zero result contamination in civic signal generation.
invariants: CONTRIBUTION_CLASSES_NEVER_SILENTLY_MIXED: Core pre-result deliberative inputs must never be combined with post-result or advocacy cohorts in official signal outputs.
BLIND_FIRST_ISOLATION: Only CORE_PRE_RESULT contributions can generate authoritative consensus signals.
SHIFT_OF_MIND_TRANSPARENCY: EXPOSED contributions are preserved and analyzed solely for cognitive shift-of-mind research, never for primary sentiment.
ADVOCACY_MOBILIZATION_SEGREGATION: ADVOCACY_SUPPORT contributions represent directed civic mobilization and must never simulate organic public deliberation.
CRYPTOGRAPHIC_ISOLATION_PROOF: A deterministic SHA-256 isolation proof hash must accompany every class breakdown to verify audit integrity.
